description: Steady-state power map for an integral PWR-type SMR with extended load-following

unit.name: Generic 540 MWth / 180 MWe Integral PWR SMR (NuScale-class)
unit.source: IAEA SMR Booklet (2022); NuScale VOYGR design certification documents

P_thermal_mw.note: Reactor module thermal power at full load

P_electric_mw.note: Net electrical output at full load

T_outlet_c.note: Primary coolant hot-leg temperature at full power

PLR_min.note: Minimum stable PLR (SMRs designed for deep load-following)

cp_coolant_kjkgk.note: Specific heat of pressurized water at ~290 degC, 127 bar

PLR_linear_derate_below.note: Below this PLR, efficiency derated linearly
